hypothesis: A single row reassigned to a different spatial block while retaining its coordinate creates an actual train/heldout position overlap; the split summary reports it and the raw-only auditor fails closed on the mutation.

H_T_D_C_U.H: For the frozen 8x8/four-block synthetic fixture, reassigning one b00 row at (0,0) to b01 causes at least one b01 block-holdout position overlap and the top-level auditor returns HOLD_AUDIT_INTEGRITY.
H_T_D_C_U.T: Run the existing 12,800-row candidate once and clean raw-only auditor once, then one frozen mutation challenge that changes only that row's block_id, inspects the split summary, and invokes the auditor once on mutated raw.
H_T_D_C_U.D: MUTATION_PASS only if clean audit is METHOD_PASS with no errors, the mutated split summary reports position_overlap_count >= 1, and corrupted raw returns HOLD_AUDIT_INTEGRITY with exactly one row_reconstruction error. Else FAIL_METHOD; execution/provenance failure is STOP.
H_T_D_C_U.C: The top-level rejection may be due to the frozen row reconstruction mismatch rather than an explicit leakage rejection. Require the lower-level split summary overlap and top-level fail-closed outcome together.
H_T_D_C_U.U: Synthetic corruption-control only; no learned model, real spatial dependence, GUI, human, calibration, safety, authority, or issue-level T1 hypothesis is tested.
